note: Patient testimony of medical files and an imaging disk that could not be found at the National Cancer Centre, Solferino (August 2026). It says the authorities have for several years announced a transition to One Patient, One Record, an electronic medical record for authorised professionals, and that government acknowledged lost medical files in Parliament; it states no tier, no place of digitisation, no clinic count, no owner, plan or budget, and no dated event for the system itself.
